notes: Reached only when neither `_auto_` nor `_manual_` is present in the base name. `base.range(of: "-", options: .backwards)` (line 962) splits on the LAST dash, so the prefix ("myworld") can itself contain dashes without breaking the timestamp parse -- only the final `-yyyyMMdd-HHmmss` suffix has to isolate cleanly. Joined with an em dash, not a hyphen.
